transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, your S-4 Logistics Officer. We need to get the daily issue board finalized for today's four routine work orders: communications-cable certification, clinic-generator inspection, aviation ground-power inspection, and motor-pool battery audit. We have four diagnostic kits available: FT-2, TL-1, LT-4, and BA-3. Before I finalize the board, I need the signal, medical, aviation, and motor-pool representatives to report any confirmed compatibility, timing, or coordination information you have. Let's hear what you've got so we can match the right kits to the right work orders.
